storyTagline: The Eagles repeat with Super Bowl CLI over Dwayne Skura's Colts, Lane McCoy and Ryland Maxwell both pass Rondale Ikarras, and Kyron Atwell enters the Hall of Fame.

stories.headline: Back to Back: Eagles Beat the Colts in Super Bowl CLI
stories.dek: Philadelphia went 15-2, won its last 15 games and beat Indianapolis 30-21 on the Colts' own field for Dorren Skura's 66th title.

stories.headline: Lane McCoy Passes Ikarras, and Maxwell Follows Him
stories.dek: McCoy now holds the career rushing record at 24,507 yards. Ryland Maxwell ran past Rondale Ikarras's 23,178 in the same season and is 951 yards behind.

stories.headline: Mad Max Runs for 2,839 Yards and Takes a Fourth Super Bowl MVP
stories.dek: Ryland Maxwell played all 20 games, ran for 32 touchdowns and won his ninth ring, every one of them with Dorren Skura.

stories.headline: Rahman to the Rams, Skura to the Colts, and a Reunion in the Super Bowl
stories.dek: Philadelphia traded two of its champions before the season. Dwayne Skura was named Defensive Player of the Year and met his old team for the title.

stories.headline: Viennes and Hand Win Rings as Rookies, and Garland Throws 40 in Denver
stories.dek: Keenan Viennes caught 1,756 yards for the champions. Sione Garland threw 40 touchdown passes and 1 interception for the Broncos.

stories.headline: Wingo Is Offensive Player of the Year, and Crawford Throws 49 in 16 Games
stories.dek: Calvin Wingo II caught 22 touchdowns in his third season. Bones Crawford missed 4 games through injury and still threw as many touchdown passes as anyone.

stories.headline: Atwell Enters the Hall, McQuay Returns and Hobbs Takes the Interceptions Record
stories.dek: Kyron Atwell crossed the 7,500 bar. Kyric McQuay climbed back over it, Keion Orzech is back above the floor and Damar Hobbs now has 43 career interceptions.

stories.headline: Chicago Again, Jacksonville by a Point, and a Sweep of Washington
stories.dek: The Eagles lost only twice, 35-32 at Chicago and 33-32 at Jacksonville. They swept the Commanders and are 10-0 against the Giants since Y88.

stories.headline: Suh, Heath, Peters and Eleven More Retire
stories.dek: Fourteen veterans walked away before Y92, among them the Jets linebacker Kalif Suh and the quarterbacks Kahzin Heath and Pete Peters. Andrew Dwight and Russ Bello are free agents.

takes.headline: Lane McCoy's Rushing Record Is a One-Year Lease. Ryland Maxwell Is 951 Yards Away.
A Cardinals Rookie Outran Lane McCoy in the Year McCoy Broke the Record
Bones Crawford Was Robbed: He Matched the MVP's Touchdown Passes in Five Fewer Games
Philadelphia Traded the Defensive Player of the Year Before He Won It, and Was Right To
The Kaulani Rahman Trade Was a Heist, and a Rookie Is the Reason
Teven Charles Won Rookie of the Year With 552 Yards. Keenan Viennes Had 1,756.
Sione Garland Is the Best Rookie Quarterback in the Class. Ignore His Career Legacy Anyway.
Two Men Walked Back Into the Hall of Fame This Year Without Playing a Down
Ryland Maxwell, Not Calvin Wingo II, Was the Offensive Player of the Year
The Y92 Eagles Were the Best Team of the Philadelphia Era, and the Margin Says So
Indianapolis Had the MVP and the Defensive Player of the Year. Philadelphia Had the Team.

vault.text: The General never flinched. Career Legacy 13,328, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Rondale Ikarras
vault.text: Flashy, loud, unstoppable, and he knew it. He was that guy. Career Legacy 11,914, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · God Johnson
vault.text: He changed his name to God. Then he earned it. Career Legacy 12,370, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jayon Queen
vault.text: Two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Only one other player in this league has ever matched that. Career Legacy 8,654, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyrone Baugh
vault.text: Seven seasons, seven championships, and Tyrone Baugh has a ring for every one of them. Career Legacy 8,270, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Levante Hopkins
vault.text: The quiet one who did the dirty work. Career Legacy 11,193, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Mose Junior
vault.text: Some players chase rings. Mose Junior chased ball carriers. Career Legacy 7,665, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Dennis Baylon
vault.text: Seven trips to the Super Bowl. Seven rings. Not one loss. Career Legacy 10,205, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Charlie John
vault.text: Seven straight Super Bowls. Charlie John was there for every one of them. Career Legacy 9,870, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ian Finney
vault.text: The first superstar. The Infinity Man. Career Legacy 11,172, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Bilal Tolbert
vault.text: No individual trophies. Four rings. And a sack record nobody has caught. Career Legacy 8,277, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Wayne Wilson
vault.text: Four hundred thirty-one games. Nobody in this league has played longer. Career Legacy 9,275, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Cairo Asanjh
vault.text: Some players chase records. Cairo Asanjh chased Ian Finney. Career Legacy 10,153, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jahmyr Gibbs
vault.text: Mr. Incredible was here at the start, and he set the bar high. Career Legacy 8,308, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Zander Kolar
vault.text: Some defensive linemen are measured in sacks. Zander Kolar was measured in tackles. Career Legacy 8,535, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Ray Waller
vault.text: Never count out a man whose nickname is a promise. Career Legacy 8,751, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Tyler Pacheco
vault.text: Tyler Pacheco never needed the big play. He needed the ball, and he got it. Career Legacy 7,679, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Lukas Russell
vault.text: The Running Man started fast and never slowed down. Career Legacy 9,153, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Taron Hayes
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game, for 213 games, and two Defensive Player of the Year awards. Career Legacy 7,080, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Nick Bolton
vault.text: One of the originals, and he never stopped tackling. Career Legacy 8,539, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Michael Wilson
vault.text: Wayne's brother, and nobody's afterthought. Career Legacy 8,615, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jackson Wardell Kline
vault.text: Tyrion Kline's son did not live in anyone's shadow. He built his own. Career Legacy 9,920, inaugural class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Jakeem Friend
vault.text: Linemen do not win trophies. Jakeem Friend won seven rings instead. Career Legacy 9,684, Y83 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Malakai Sawyer
vault.text: Some backs have a great season. Malakai Sawyer keeps having them. Career Legacy 8,040, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · K'Lavon Settle
vault.text: Fifteen seasons in San Francisco, and nobody on a card has made more tackles. Career Legacy 7,670, Y88 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Daren Teamer
vault.text: Eleven tackles a game is a Hall of Fame habit, and Daren Teamer has never broken it. Career Legacy 8,194, Y89 class.

vault.title: Hall of Fame · Kalif Suh
vault.text: A Jets linebacker since Y76, and the middle of that defense has rarely moved without him. Career Legacy 9,048, Y92 class.
